name: BUA Foods
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 5 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Operating Profit (EBIT) - Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT), and the column ties with it positive
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Selling and distribution 30,437,849 plus administrative 14,497,069 (NGN thousands)
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

source_note: H1 2026 column rebuilt 2026-10-06 from the issuer H1 2026 unaudited results press release (BUA Foods Plc, H1 2026 unaudited results, filed on NGX as doclib 47725, 30 July 2026), in thousands of naira: Revenue 765,119,203; Cost of Sales 401,886,654; Gross Profit 363,232,549; Operating Expenses 44,934,918 (selling and distribution 30,437,849 plus administrative 14,497,069); Other income 2,223,771; Operating Profit 320,521,403; Net Finance Costs 5,639,986 (finance cost net); Profit Before Tax 314,881,416; Income Taxes 22,614,914; Profit for the period 292,266,502; EPS 16.24 (the release labels the EPS row kobo, but 292.27bn over 18.0bn shares is 16.24 naira). UNIT: NGN. Prior H1 2026 cell set was wrong: Cost of Sales had been back-filled as Revenue minus Net Profit and Gross Profit, Operating Profit and Profit Before Tax had all been set to the Net Profit figure. Identities checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax = Net Profit.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2023; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note). Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2022: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
periodOrder: repaired 2026-10-04: periods were not newest-first; reordered so periods[0] is the newest period and every value stays on its own period label
